record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare AQUA_STEP: Quaxly (1 star), Quaxwell (2 stars) and Quaquaval (3 stars); all have range 1 and maxPP 100 and no passive. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (table index).
record.summary: The caster steps one cell toward the cast target (to the empty cell closest to the cell one sign-step away), then 300 ms later deals SPECIAL damage (raw 25/50/100/200 by stars) to the cast target and gains raw speed 10/15/20/25 (by stars; AP-scaled).

targeting.who: the cast target (damage); caster itself (step and speed gain)
targeting.note: The step uses the cast target's position at cast time; the delayed damage uses the target's entity (its position is read again for the broadcast only). The damage is queued whether or not a step cell was found.

geometry.shape: one-cell step: destination = closest empty cell (Manhattan) to (caster.x + sign(dx), caster.y + sign(dy)); single-target damage afterwards

effects.scaling: requested = table value. applied by handleSpecialDamage: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost true by default); x critPower (adjusted by target items) if the cast crit.
effects.resolution: then PokemonState.handleDamage: divided by 1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x SPE_DEF, at least 1, shield absorbs before HP; protect / skydiving / magicBounce on the target at the time the command fires block the hit entirely. takenDamage includes shield damage.

effects.scaling: requested = table value. applied by addSpeed: Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down for a holder; then x(1 + AP/100) with apBoost 1, x critPower if the cast crit (no rounding); then speed = clamp(speed + value, 0, MAX_SPEED = 300).
effects.resolution: requested (table) -> applied (after belt, AP, crit) -> actual change (after the 0..300 clamp). No timer or removal in this file.
moveTo(x, y, board, false) when a free cell exists: swap with the empty cell, cooldown set to 100.

starBehavior.note: both tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star values (200 damage, +25 speed) are not reachable at the bare factory star counts of these units. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: The step needs an empty cell on the board; with none, the caster stays. A target already adjacent still triggers a step toward it, ending on the closest empty cell to the sign-step cell (which may be the target's own cell, so the nearest free neighbour is used).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast queues its own delayed command, and the speed gain stacks additively across casts (up to MAX_SPEED).
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 25/50/100 and speed +10/15/20 (1/2/3 stars). Damage dealt = raw x (1 + AP/100) (x crit factor), then SPE_DEF division, minimum 1; shield damage is included in takenDamage. Speed applied = floor(raw x 1.25) with a Big Eater Belt, then x (1 + AP/100) x crit factor, then clamped to 0..300. None is computed here for a specific target or caster.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after later modifiers in handleDamage (shields, items, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPE_DEF division and the minimum of 1 were read
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
unresolved: Whether the delayed command still runs (and whether the damage and speed gain still apply) if the caster dies or the simulation ends before 300 ms: the removal of a dead entity's commands was not traced
Whether the damage call is skipped or redirected if the target has died or moved by the time the command fires (the code calls handleSpecialDamage on the stored target entity unconditionally)
Tie order among equally close empty cells depends on board.forEach order and the stability of Array.prototype.sort (not verified beyond reading)
Whether the three units ever reach a different star count than the factory value
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
